item.title: Resident Evil: Biohazard Unleashed
item.description: The ultimate Resident Evil Bundle is here
item.content:encoded:
Burst zombie skulls in the ultimate collection of genre-defining survival games with our latest Bundle with CAPCOM. Resident Evil continues to set the bar high for more than two decades after its humble debut—experience HD Remasters of old-school entries and newer installments like Resident Evil Village: Gold Edition and Resident Evil 7 biohazard Gold Edition carrying on the legacy. Plus, get every mainline installment leading up to these iconic titles. Experience the complete saga at an unbelievable price—and help support the Raiden Science Foundation with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before June 2nd, 2027.

item.title: Crimes and Curiosity Bundle by S2 Games
item.content:encoded:
Rewind time with a curated library of iconic and reimagined mysteries with the Crimes and Curiosity Bundle by S2 Games! Experience the award-winning classic adventure Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars: Reforged with revamped 4K visuals, remastered audio, and endless charm. Investigate historical conspiracies in the post-WWII noir thriller The Darkest Files, solve cyberpunk cases in Gamedec - Definitive Edition, and more. Satisfy your curiosity for solving crimes and help support The Global FoodBanking Network with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 23rd, 2027.

item.title: Tactical Mindset Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Mastermind every challenge in this bundle of turn-based tactics games from Plug In Digital! Lead a company of fearless heroes against epic boss battles in Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent! Master destructive card combos with the power of Wakfu in One More Gate : A Wakfu Legend! Rise through the ranks of an orbiting penitentiary and become the head of your own gang in Space Prison! With even more strategy-forward games to test your calculation, pay what you want and support Safe In Our World with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 20th, 2027.

item.title: Maximum Entertainment Indie Hits
item.content:encoded:
It always feels extra special when an independently created game gets the hype and popularity it deserves. To celebrate our favorite breakout indie hits we’ve collected them all in one bundle of endless fun! Wreak havoc as a furry neighborhood menace sporting a fluffy tail and a firearm in Squirrel with a Gun! Explore a vast, hand-drawn fantasy world packed with fierce boss battles in Afterimage! Unravel an emotional, bittersweet mystery through a fateful journey of growing up in Until Then! All of these and more are included in this bundle of indie favorites, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Spaceship Earth with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 11th, 2027.

item.title: Horror Trifectas
item.content:encoded:
Save big on a curated collection of horror games that celebrate the season by delivering exceptional scares! Take on F.E.A.R. 1-3, where you play as a First Encounter Assault Recon member tasked with saving hostages from a mysterious paramilitary force in campaigns filled with tension and unmatched terror! Or brave DreadOut 1-3, the third-person horror adventures that draw inspiration from Indonesian urban legends. Unlock the most frighteningly fun horror trilogies today and help support Gamers Outreach with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 18th, 2027.

item.title: Marmalade Game Studio: Ultimate Digital Game Night
item.description: Level up your board game nights
item.content:encoded:
We all love board games, but it can be tricky to find space to play and keep track of all the little pieces. That’s why we’ve teamed up with the folks at Marmalade Game Studio to bring your favorite classic board game adventures to the digital realm! Hop aboard your fastest engine and cover the country in railroad tracks in Ticket to Ride! Find out whodunit, and in which room, and with what weapon in the murder mystery classic Clue/Cluedo! Make good choices and live your best life in The Game of Life and The Game of Life 2! There’s tons more digital board game fun to be had in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choosing, and support Little Village with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 16th, 2027.

item.title: Phunkier Physics
item.content:encoded:
Use the laws of physics to your advantage in this bundle of physics-based games that allow your engineering imagination to run wild! Get your gears turning and build war machines to win every conflict in Besiege Master Engineer Edition! Design your own ships and bases to explore the far reaches of outer space in Space Engineers! Build a menagerie of virtual pets out of delightfully weird and constantly mutating forms in the all-ages favorite Wobbledogs! Stretch the laws of the universe to the limit with these physics engineering games of all genres, and have fun while doing it! Pay what you want for this bundle of games and support the National Kidney Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 13th, 2027.

item.title: Puzzlers to Puzzle You
item.content:encoded:
Give your brain a workout with this bundle of extra-puzzling puzzle games! Solve your way through exciting stories built on a foundation of brain-tickling puzzles and riddles. Explore a creepy mansion full of secrets in the newly revamped The 7th Guest Remake! Follow a nun on a journey with the devil himself to discover the secrets of a surreal vision of Russia in INDIKA! Explore a network of islands to teach adorable monsters about human culture in the open-world puzzle game A Monster’s Expedition! There are even more unique challenges to be solved in this bundle of puzzling games, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support BuildOn with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 13th, 2027.

item.title: 15th Anniversary - Sci-Fi Exposure
item.description: Sci-fi like you’ve never seen before
item.content:encoded:
Celebrate 15 years of Humble Bundle with this collection of our favorite sci-fi games! In this bundle you’ll explore far-flung futures, survive hostile alien planets, and sink your teeth into intergalactic battles that feel realer than real. Get a piece of the action in Marathon, a first-person shooter set aboard a giant spaceship orbiting a colony in crisis! Resist an alien invasion and wage war against a technologically advanced enemy in the strategy game Xenonauts 2! Save the world from a corporate conspiracy in Crysis 3 Remastered! There are many more worlds and visions of the future to explore in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choice and support Charity: water with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 11th, 2027.

item.title: Flat2VR Bundle
item.description: Play VR games that never fall flat!
item.content:encoded:
Lose yourself in new worlds! Explore an epic collection of reality-bending games by Flat2VR Studios and discover what’s possible with the power of VR. Play Roboquest VR, the lightning-fast roguelite FPS where firepower and speed are king, brave I AM YOUR BEAST VR, the thrilling adaptation of Strange Scaffold’s short-form covert revenge story, or get your adrenaline pumping in VRacer Hoverbike. Don’t wait another second, now’s the perfect time to try VR gaming! Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support Take This.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 10th, 2027.

item.title: Serenity Forge Emotional Impact Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Get in touch with your sensitive side with this bundle of games from Serenity Forge! These emotional journeys will lead you through layered family dramas and post-apocalyptic deserts where humanity is the only thing we have left. Travel through a wasteland full of mutants in search of family in LISA: the Painful and LISA: The Joyful! Discover what immortality truly costs in the eerie RPG Death’s Gambit: Afterlife! Search through your childhood house to find your missing family in Gone Home! Exciting adventures and moving storytelling await in this bundle of the best from Serenity Forge. Grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 6th, 2027.

item.title: Double Fine Publisher Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Get the best of Double Fine in this bundle of the video game publisher’s greatest hits! Embrace your psychic powers and battle inside the minds of your enemies in Psychonauts! Explore a fantasy world with a heavy metal twist and save the universe with the power of rock in Brütal Legend! Take control of your fate with two teenagers from fantastically different worlds in the gorgeously hand-animated Broken Age! Explore all of these games and more in this bundle from Double Fine! You choose what you pay, and support Double Fine’s indie game making charity Day of the Devs with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 6th, 2027.

item.title: The Factory Must Grow
item.content:encoded:
The factories are open for business. This construction-focused bundle offers builder-style games with a wide range of flavors, ranging from complex space expeditions to cozy, relaxing island sims. Strap on your helmet for Eden Crafters, the ultimate open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform far-off planets into close-knit communities; terraform a dying planet back to health in Blossom: The Seed of Life; or try Oddsparks for a unique blend of automation and real-time strategy! Pay what you want for great games and help support TD Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

item.title: Hamble's Fright or Fight Halloween Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Spooky season calls for Humble’s Fright or Flight Halloween Bundle! Leave the lights on for Blair Witch, a story-driven psychological horror experience based on the cinematic lore of the iconic Blair Witch franchise. Explore the real world and spiritual realm as the protagonist of The Medium in a gripping, horror-filled exploration of your past traumas, or call your friends and gobble up DEVOUR, the 1 to 4-player horror survival game where you’ll stop cultists from carrying out their wicked plans. Enjoy frightening savings on the hottest horror games, and help support the WDC with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

item.title: Gals and Pals: PQube Japanese Games
item.description: Explore PQube’s gorgeous girls of gaming
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Fall into an intimate bundle of spicy Japanese games with the Gals and Pals Bundle published by PQube! Turn up the heat in Gal*Gun Returns, a colorfully reimagined version of the first game that started it all, the sensual sequel Gal*Gun 2, or the action-packed Gal*Gun: Double Peace! Massage your romantic impulses with these rail-shooters of beautiful bubbly girls, and fulfill your euphoric fantasies where bullets have been replaced with enchanting pheromone shots! Unwrap steamy gal-pal fun for a price you choose and help support Cool Effect with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

item.title: Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novels
item.description: Twisted trilogies and terrifying tales await.
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Sink your teeth into the Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novel Bundle, a seasonal collection of scary games! Choose from a trio of Spirit Hunter titles, including the critically acclaimed Death Mark II. Spooky supernatural studies are in session within the halls of Tokyo’s Konoehara Academy, and it’s your duty as a Spirit Doctor to cleanse the prestigious academy’s classrooms with your partner. Or try Class of '09, a trilogy of anti-visual novel games where you play as a beautiful heroine who causes chaos for every suitor who tries to gain your affection. Plus, your purchase helps support Movember!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

item.title: Indie Fighters
item.content:encoded:
You’d better brush up on your combat skills if you want to take on these indie fighting games! Harness the power of the four elements to clobber your opponents to dust in Rivals of Aether II! Get a kick out of a modern fighting game with a retro arcade-inspired aesthetic in Pocket Bravery! Go back to basics and battle your enemies using just two buttons in the simple yet effective Divekick! Explore even more fighting game fun in this bundle of brawlers—you choose what you pay, and every purchase supports the rare disease research organization Raiden Science Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.
